preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of queries Q for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each query integer X must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers E and O representing the counts of even and odd 1-bits in the binary representation of elements in S.
